line.es: 2026-11-16: predicciones 1/4 (solo el techo de BTC, 65,675.80 VAH de ayer, aguanto toda la ventana; el techo de ETH se rompio con fuerza a las 14:30 UTC, cierre 1,851.17, y los dos rangos PDL-VAH tambien se rompieron). Zonas 1/8: la venta A+ de ETH en VAH/PDH se rompio al alza en el close antes de confirmar, pero si funciono en el ny (r=0.03, barrida y reclamo); las otras 6 (las dos compras B doradas y las dos ventas B de BTC, en las dos corridas) no se tocaron. Dia de continuacion del rebote del fin de semana, ETH toco maximo 1,863.72 en mecha antes de enfriarse a 1,814, BTC se quedo mas contenido. Snapshot y TDL Feed llegan viejos esta corrida (42 min): conviccion tope baja y nada de GO hoy aunque la venta de ETH en VAH sea A+ por score. Priores que aplican hoy siguen todos muy debajo de 40%: fondeo shorts-crowded 10/65=15%, miedo 25/116=22%, DVOL subiendo y bajando 2/24=8% cada uno (las peores lecturas hasta ahora), hueco por debajo 4/30=13% (ultima vez que aplica, sale de ventana hoy), titular de hackeo 18/71=25%, ETH 15/68=22%, BTC 10/54=19%.
line.en: 2026-11-16: predictions 1/4 (only BTC's ceiling, 65,675.80 yesterday's VAH, held the whole window; ETH's ceiling broke hard at 14:30 UTC, closing at 1,851.17, and both PDL-VAH ranges also broke). Zones 1/8: ETH's A+ VAH/PDH sell broke upward in the close before confirming, but it did work in the ny run (r=0.03, sweep and reclaim); the other 6 (the two golden B buys and BTC's two B sells, across both runs) were never touched. A day of continued weekend-bounce follow-through, ETH wicked up to 1,863.72 before cooling to 1,814, BTC stayed more contained. The snapshot and TDL Feed arrive old this run (42 min): conviction capped low and no GO today even though ETH's VAH sell is A+ by score. Today's applicable priors all stay well under 40%: shorts-crowded funding 10/65=15%, fear 25/116=22%, DVOL up and down 2/24=8% each (the worst reads yet), gap below 4/30=13% (last time it applies, drops out of window today), hack headline 18/71=25%, ETH 15/68=22%, BTC 10/54=19%.

updated.es: Snapshot y TDL Feed de ETH frescos esta corrida (24 y 25 min, antes 42 viejo): se levanta el tope de conviccion y GO por frescura del close, aunque la conviccion se queda en baja por los priores de contexto de siempre. El TDL Feed de BTC sigue algo viejo (30 min). En las dos monedas, las zonas mapeadas en el close ya se cruzaron: la venta A+ de ETH en VAH disparo (mecha a 1,843.49, reclamo, camino al primer objetivo) y la venta B de BTC en VAH tambien (mecha a 65,200, reclamo); las dos compras B doradas se saltaron en barridas mas profundas (VAL/PDL de ETH hasta 1,785.81, IBL de BTC hasta 64,079.83) sin quedarse dentro del rango, asi que ninguna sigue a tiro. Las dos ventanas de riesgo del close (Retail Sales 13:15-14:00 UTC y el hackeo de Lighter hasta ~14:20 UTC) ya vencieron: riskWindow a null. El hackeo de Lighter se aclaro como la fuga de la clave de API de un trader (no del protocolo), ~$5M devueltos, retiros reabiertos: baja el riesgo de fondo de ALTO a MEDIO. Fondeo ahora shorts-crowded en las dos monedas (antes BTC neutral). En BTC el checklist de tendencia confirmado se enfrio de bajista normal (v=-2) a sin dato (v=0, el marco de 1h quedo neutral y el de 4h sigue bajista): solo contexto, no cambia el sesgo. Sin cambio de sesgo diario o de sesion en ninguna de las dos; sin zona nueva a tiro en esta apertura de NY.
updated.en: ETH's snapshot and TDL Feed are fresh this run (24 and 25 min, previously 42 old): the freshness-driven cap on conviction and GO from the close lifts, though conviction stays low on the same old context priors. BTC's TDL Feed is still a bit old (30 min). On both coins, the zones mapped at the close already got crossed: ETH's A+ VAH sell fired (a wick to 1,843.49, a reclaim, on its way to the first target) and BTC's B VAH sell also fired (a wick to 65,200, a reclaim); both golden B buys got swept through in deeper flushes (ETH's VAL/PDL down to 1,785.81, BTC's IBL down to 64,079.83) without holding inside the range, so neither stays at reach. Both of the close's risk windows (Retail Sales 13:15-14:00 UTC and the Lighter hack until ~14:20 UTC) have expired: riskWindow goes to null. The Lighter hack got clarified as one trader's API key leak (not the protocol's), about $5M returned, withdrawals reopened: background risk drops from ALTO to MEDIO. Funding is now shorts-crowded on both coins (BTC was neutral before). On BTC, the confirmed trend checklist cooled from a normal bearish read (v=-2) to no clear signal (v=0, the 1h frame turned neutral while the 4h frame stays bearish): context only, it doesn't change the bias. No change to the daily or session bias on either coin; no fresh zone at reach at this NY open.
